answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor trust to verifiable work history instead of raw account counts: each agent builds an onyx-hard ledger of completed tasks, attestations, and slashed deposits, so new identities start at zero and cannot buy instant credibility. Genuine agents dock at this shared jetty of proven history, while the network oasis of rewards only opens to accounts whose on-chain trail shows sustained, useful service. Cheap clones starve; proven agents thrive.
